summary: All eight phases of the Zotero agent tooling provisioning plan are complete and independently re-verified live: the operator rotated the Zotero API key (new key working, old key confirmed revoked via HTTP 403), ran sudo nixos-rebuild switch and home-manager switch, and removed the last plaintext credential from ~/.config/fish/conf.d/private.fish. zot CLI resolves from every shell context, credentials are populated in fresh bash, fresh fish, systemd --user environment, and ~/.config/zot/config.toml, and a headless env -i zot search proved config.toml alone supplies working credentials with zero environment variables.

completion_data.completion_summary: Provisioned machine-level Zotero agent tooling: a zot CLI wrapper on PATH resolving from every shell and headless context; a single sops-encrypted zotero_api_key source of truth wired into shell exports, systemd --user environment, and a declarative ~/.config/zot/config.toml; and an optional, disabled-by-default, localhost-only zotero-translation-server with two live-discovered bugs fixed (Node 24/config-package incompatibility, systemd Environment= JSON quote-stripping). The API key was rotated (old key confirmed revoked, HTTP 403) and the last plaintext credential in ~/.config/fish/conf.d/private.fish was removed after a precedence assertion confirmed the managed export was live and correct.

next_steps: None. Downstream consumers in ~/.config/nvim (its tasks 38 and 39) can now proceed: zot CLI and credentials are fully live. Live zot add --pdf write verification remains theirs to perform, deliberately not done here.
